definitions.gloss: custom-made item; made-to-order product; special order
definitions.explanation: An item that is specially ordered or made according to customer specifications, as opposed to ready-made items.

examples.japanese: {注文品|ちゅうもんひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{返品|へんぴん}→返品：05465_henpin⟧⟦できません→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{注文品|ちゅうもんひん}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: This furniture is a custom order, so it will take time.

examples.japanese: {注文品|ちゅうもんひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受|う}け{取|と}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{身分証|みぶんしょう}→身分証：11508_mibunshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: ID is required to pick up custom orders.

notes:
{注文品|ちゅうもんひん} is commonly seen in retail and e-commerce contexts.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{既製品|きせいひん}→既製品：08304_kiseihin⟧: ready-made product
- {特注品|とくちゅうひん}: specially ordered item (often implies customization)
- オーダー⟦メイド→メイド：12377_meido⟧: custom-made (from English)
- {受注生産|じゅちゅうせいさん}: made-to-order production

USAGE:
{注文品|ちゅうもんひん} often has return restrictions. Signs saying 「{注文品|ちゅうもんひん}⟦につき→につき：17196_nitsuki⟧⟦{返品|へんぴん}→返品：05465_henpin⟧⟦{不可|ふか}→不可：01922_fuka⟧」 (custom orders non-returnable) are common.
